optional_fields.x: integer consistent with index modulo width
optional_fields.y: integer consistent with index divided by width

visibility.semantics: exact packet-known tile indexes visible to the requested player

entities.semantics: own cities and units retain exact packet coordinates; visible foreign units remain observational and are never promoted into own_state

event_projection.tile_normalization: state_snapshot.map.tiles retains every supplied field and adds index/x/y consistency
event_projection.visibility_normalization: state_snapshot.map exposes both visible_tile_ids and derived coordinate pairs
event_projection.coverage: state_snapshot.map.coverage explicitly distinguishes complete, partial, and dimensions_only streams
event_projection.visible_foreign_units: state_snapshot.map.visible_enemy_units remains separate from authoritative own_state
event_projection.spatial_plan_targets: grounded impact plan steps copy exact action target x/y into step.spatial

fail_closed: tile indexes outside the map are rejected
tile coordinates inconsistent with their index are rejected
visibility indexes outside the map are rejected
missing terrain or visibility is emitted as an explicit coverage gap and is never reconstructed from entity positions
invariants: pressure, planning, and visualization consume the same immutable snapshot identity
rendering coordinates never creates truth, legality, or map knowledge
legacy empty tile arrays remain readable as dimensions_only evidence
future tile fields are retained losslessly in state_snapshot events
